subtopics.name: Quantum channel capacities and additivity
subtopics.scope: Classical, quantum, private and entanglement-assisted capacities of noisy quantum channels, including degradability, superadditivity and single-letter formulas.

subtopics.name: Quantum entropies and divergence inequalities
subtopics.scope: Properties of von Neumann, Rényi, and smooth min/max entropies and relative entropies, including continuity bounds, uncertainty relations and one-shot quantities.

subtopics.name: Quantum hypothesis testing and state discrimination
subtopics.scope: Optimal measurements and error probabilities for distinguishing quantum states or channels, from single-shot Helstrom bounds to asymptotic Chernoff and Stein exponents.

subtopics.name: Structure and characterization of quantum channels
subtopics.scope: Mathematical properties of completely positive maps, such as Choi-Kraus representations, extremality, divisibility, covariance, and positivity versus complete positivity.

subtopics.name: Entanglement detection and quantification
subtopics.scope: Separability criteria, entanglement witnesses and computable entanglement measures for bipartite and multipartite mixed states.

subtopics.name: LOCC entanglement manipulation and majorization
subtopics.scope: Convertibility, distillation, dilution and catalysis of entangled states under local operations and classical communication.

subtopics.name: Bell nonlocality, steering, and nonlocal games
subtopics.scope: Correlations that violate local-hidden-variable or local-hidden-state models, their quantum bounds, nonlocal games and measurement incompatibility.

subtopics.name: Contextuality and Kochen-Specker scenarios
subtopics.scope: State-dependent and state-independent contextuality, Kochen-Specker sets, noncontextuality inequalities and their graph-theoretic characterizations.

subtopics.name: Mutually unbiased bases and SIC-POVMs
subtopics.scope: Construction, existence and properties of mutually unbiased bases, symmetric informationally complete measurements and related designs in finite dimensions.

subtopics.name: Haar-random states, unitaries and designs
subtopics.scope: Typical properties of Haar-random states and unitaries, and how random circuits converge to unitary t-designs.

subtopics.name: Stabilizer codes and quantum code bounds
subtopics.scope: Construction of stabilizer, CSS and LDPC quantum codes, their parameters, and fundamental bounds on rate and distance.

subtopics.name: Topological codes and fault-tolerance thresholds
subtopics.scope: Surface, toric and color codes, their decoders, and error thresholds under various noise models.

subtopics.name: Bosonic codes in oscillator modes
subtopics.scope: Encoding qubits in harmonic oscillators with GKP, cat, binomial and rotation-symmetric codes, and how these codes perform under loss and dephasing.

subtopics.name: Magic state distillation and fault-tolerant gadgets
subtopics.scope: Protocols for universal fault-tolerant computation, including magic state distillation, code switching, and estimates of overheads and thresholds.

subtopics.name: Dynamical decoupling and noise filtering
subtopics.scope: Pulse sequences that suppress decoherence, and the filter-function description of qubits subject to classical or quantum noise spectra.

subtopics.name: Randomized benchmarking and noise characterization
subtopics.scope: Estimating average gate fidelities, error rates and noise models of quantum devices with randomized protocols and process tomography.

subtopics.name: Quantum query algorithms and complexity
subtopics.scope: Query-model algorithms such as search, period finding and hidden subgroup problems, and lower bounds on their query complexity.

subtopics.name: Hamiltonian simulation and quantum signal processing
subtopics.scope: Algorithms that implement time evolution or matrix functions on quantum computers, including product formulas, LCU, qubitization and QSVT.

subtopics.name: Quantum walks on graphs and state transfer
subtopics.scope: Discrete- and continuous-time quantum walks, their spreading, hitting and search properties, and perfect or pretty-good state transfer in spin networks.

subtopics.name: Adiabatic quantum computation and annealing
subtopics.scope: Computation by slow Hamiltonian interpolation, focusing on spectral gaps, diabatic errors and annealing schedules for optimization problems.

subtopics.name: QAOA and variational quantum algorithms
subtopics.scope: Parameterized quantum circuits optimized by a classical loop, including QAOA performance guarantees, variational eigensolvers and trainability issues.

subtopics.name: Quantum Hamiltonian complexity and local Hamiltonians
subtopics.scope: The complexity of estimating ground energies and other properties of local Hamiltonians, including QMA-completeness, circuit-to-Hamiltonian constructions and perturbative gadgets.

subtopics.name: Classical simulation of restricted quantum circuits
subtopics.scope: Efficient or near-efficient classical algorithms for Clifford, matchgate, low-magic, low-entanglement and noisy circuits, and the resources that make simulation hard.

subtopics.name: Quantum gate synthesis and circuit compilation
subtopics.scope: Decomposing unitaries into gate sets, minimizing gate counts and depth, and the structure of Clifford and Clifford+T circuits.

subtopics.name: Measurement-based computation and graph states
subtopics.scope: One-way quantum computing on cluster and graph states, and the entanglement structure, local equivalence and resource properties of those states.

subtopics.name: Quantum key distribution security and rates
subtopics.scope: Security proofs and achievable secret key rates for discrete- and continuous-variable QKD protocols with realistic imperfections.

subtopics.name: Quantum two-party cryptography and coin flipping
subtopics.scope: Cryptographic primitives between parties who distrust each other, such as coin flipping, bit commitment, oblivious transfer and position verification, with their optimal biases and impossibility results.

subtopics.name: Quantum repeaters and entanglement distribution
subtopics.scope: Protocols for distributing entanglement over lossy links using swapping, purification and quantum memories, with analysis of their rates and fidelities.

subtopics.name: Optimal cloning and quantum state estimation
subtopics.scope: Fundamental limits on copying, broadcasting and estimating unknown quantum states from finitely many copies, including optimal covariant measurements and tomography.

subtopics.name: Quantum metrology and parameter estimation
subtopics.scope: Precision limits for estimating physical parameters with quantum probes, including Heisenberg scaling, the effects of noise, and multiparameter bounds.

subtopics.name: Open quantum systems and master equations
subtopics.scope: Markovian and non-Markovian dynamics of systems coupled to environments, including Lindblad, Redfield and exactly solvable spin-boson-type models.

subtopics.name: Continuous measurement and quantum feedback
subtopics.scope: Dynamics of continuously monitored quantum systems, described by stochastic master equations and quantum trajectories, and feedback control based on the measurement record.

subtopics.name: Quantum thermodynamics and work extraction
subtopics.scope: Work, heat and efficiency in quantum systems, including heat engines, batteries, fluctuation theorems and thermal operations.

subtopics.name: Resource theories of coherence and magic
subtopics.scope: Axiomatic quantification and conversion of resources such as coherence, asymmetry and non-stabilizerness under restricted sets of free operations.

subtopics.name: Gaussian continuous-variable quantum information
subtopics.scope: Quantum information with Gaussian states and operations of bosonic modes, including entanglement, channels and capacities in phase space.

subtopics.name: Linear optics, interferometry and boson sampling
subtopics.scope: Multiphoton interference in passive linear-optical networks, its computational complexity, and its applications to photonic quantum computing.

subtopics.name: Many-body entanglement and tensor networks
subtopics.scope: How entanglement scales in ground and excited states of lattice models, and how matrix product states and related tensor networks represent it.

subtopics.name: Relativistic quantum information and field entanglement
subtopics.scope: Entanglement and quantum information in quantum fields and in curved or accelerated settings, including Unruh-DeWitt detectors and entanglement harvesting.

subtopics.name: Superconducting, trapped-ion and atomic qubit physics
subtopics.scope: Theoretical models of physical qubit platforms, including circuit QED, trapped-ion gates and Rydberg-atom arrays, and of their gate errors.

subtopics.name: Quantum speed limits and optimal control
subtopics.scope: Minimal evolution times and optimal control fields for preparing states and implementing gates under constraints.

techniques.name: Semidefinite programming and duality bounds
techniques.scope: Formulate optimal guessing probabilities, Bell values, fidelities or channel norms as SDPs and certify the exact optimum with matching primal and dual solutions.

techniques.name: Weingarten calculus for Haar averages
techniques.scope: Evaluate moments of Haar-random unitaries and states with Weingarten functions and permutation sums to get exact averages and variances.

techniques.name: Schur-Weyl duality and representation theory
techniques.scope: Decompose tensor-power spaces into irreducible representations of the unitary and symmetric groups, reducing symmetric problems to low-dimensional ones.

techniques.name: Binary symplectic stabilizer algebra
techniques.scope: Represent Pauli and Clifford operations as vectors and matrices over GF(2) to compute code parameters, logical operators and counts of stabilizer objects.

techniques.name: Discrete Fourier analysis and character sums
techniques.scope: Use Fourier transforms over finite groups and fields, Gauss sums and MacWilliams identities to construct bases, analyze algorithms and relate weight distributions.

techniques.name: Statistical-mechanics mapping of decoding thresholds
techniques.scope: Map optimal decoding of topological codes onto disordered spin models or percolation problems to locate error thresholds.

techniques.name: Symplectic and Bogoliubov mode transformations
techniques.scope: Diagonalize Gaussian covariance matrices and quadratic mode Hamiltonians with Williamson normal forms and Bogoliubov transformations to get entropies, entanglement and particle content.

techniques.name: Phase-space quasiprobability representations
techniques.scope: Use continuous or discrete Wigner, Husimi and characteristic functions to compute overlaps, negativity and channel actions in closed form.

techniques.name: Quantum Fisher information calculus
techniques.scope: Compute the symmetric-logarithmic-derivative QFI, Bures metrics and their extensions to channels to get exact precision bounds and optimal probe states.

techniques.name: Convex-roof and symmetry-reduced entanglement evaluation
techniques.scope: Use symmetries (twirling, Werner and isotropic families) and convex-roof constructions to get closed-form entanglement and resource measures.

techniques.name: Entropic inequalities and converse bounds
techniques.scope: Chain data-processing, subadditivity and continuity inequalities to derive tight converse bounds on rates and capacities.

techniques.name: Large-deviation and second-order asymptotics
techniques.scope: Derive error exponents, Chernoff and Hoeffding bounds, and Gaussian second-order corrections for asymptotic information-processing tasks.

techniques.name: Liouvillian spectral analysis of master equations
techniques.scope: Vectorize Lindblad generators and solve for their spectra, steady states and relaxation times, either exactly or by third quantization.

techniques.name: Free-fermion correlation-matrix methods
techniques.scope: Solve quadratic fermionic models with the Jordan-Wigner mapping and correlation matrices, using Toeplitz or Fisher-Hartwig asymptotics for entanglement.

techniques.name: Schrieffer-Wolff and perturbative effective Hamiltonians
techniques.scope: Derive low-energy effective couplings, dispersive shifts and gadget interactions by perturbative block diagonalization.

techniques.name: Spectral gap bounds and adiabatic theorems
techniques.scope: Bound or compute the gaps of Hamiltonians, graph Laplacians and Markov chains, and convert them into adiabatic run times, hitting times or mixing times.

techniques.name: BCH, Magnus and nested-commutator expansions
techniques.scope: Expand time-ordered or product-formula evolutions in commutators to get leading error terms, average Hamiltonians and filter functions.

techniques.name: Polynomial approximation and Chebyshev methods
techniques.scope: Use Chebyshev and minimax polynomial approximations to build quantum signal processing sequences and to prove polynomial-method query lower bounds.

techniques.name: Transfer matrices and tensor-network contraction
techniques.scope: Compute correlation lengths, norms and entanglement of MPS-like states, or classical partition functions, from transfer-matrix spectra.

techniques.name: Lie-algebraic and Cartan decomposition methods
techniques.scope: Use Lie algebra structure, Cartan (KAK) decompositions and dynamical Lie algebras to determine controllability, optimal gate times and invariants.
